messages:
Asha (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today’s All-Hands Q&A. I'll drop the short answers here for managers to share in 1:1s.

Ben (Eng Manager): Thanks. Two asks: promo timeline + appeals window?

Asha (People Ops): Timeline: manager packets due 2026-08-10, calibration panels 2026-08-17, letters 2026-08-24. Appeals open for 14 calendar days after letters.

Noor (SWE): If someone is promoted, does equity refresh happen automatically?

Talia (Comp): Not automatic. Include an equity request in the packet with rationale; equity committee reviews with comp.

Ben (Eng Manager): Payroll ops Q: retro pay if appeal approved?

Talia (Comp): Approved base increases are backdated to the cycle effective date noted in the committee memo and paid on the next payroll after HR posts the change.

Noor (SWE): Will managers get a script for "not promoted" convos?

Asha (People Ops): Yes 1 manager script + 3-step growth plan template will be posted to the handbook by 2026-08-12.

PeopleBot: Reminder: upload calibration packet to /handbook/people-ops/calibration/2026 by 2026-08-10. :pushpin:

Sam (CEO): Leadership request: be concrete and kind. Escalate tough cases to me + Asha with a 2-sentence rationale.

Asha (People Ops): Action items (copy/paste): manager script by 2026-08-12; packets due 2026-08-10; letters 2026-08-24; appeals 14 days. Ping me for urgent escalations. :sparkles:
